subtasks: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
Move the right gripper up and clear. Use the left gripper to pick up the purple 8 from the middle foreground and place it upright on the leftmost round pad.
Use the left gripper to place the purple 5 upright on the second round pad from the left.
Use the right gripper to place the purple 2 upright on the third round pad from the left.

Use the left gripper to move the purple 1 from beside the toothpaste to the clear front-center of the table, leaving it flat and upright for the right gripper. Leave the three placed numbers on their pads.
Use the right gripper to pick up the purple 1 from the center foreground and place it flat, upright, and centered on the fourth round pad from the left. Keep the other digits in place.
